subject: an unrolled scroll with short ruled lines
sourceSummary: Turn raw commit/PR history into a human-readable changelog that users actually understand: a developer first gathers and triages the merged changes since the last release into user-facing buckets (Added, Changed, Fixed, Deprecated, Removed, Security), filtering out noise like internal refactors, then a copywriter rewrites each entry in plain, benefit-oriented language with breaking changes called out.
